summary: Added a self-modification hazard gate to /orchestrate admission: a data-declared nine-file critical-path set, a v2 verdict schema (self_modifying + defer_reason discriminator), invocation-scoped solo-only deferral wired into both live dispatch paths with a convergent deferred_self_modifying exclusion set, dry-run report visibility, and a new 14-assertion test suite plus updated v2 regression across all four test suites (14/14, 8/8, 6/6, 14/14 all green).

artifacts.summary: Full implementation summary: 5 phases, files changed, decisions, deviations, verification.

decisions_made: Self-modification check runs first and short-circuits the collision scan (D4), verified via a dedicated precedence fixture.
--invocation-count threads the whole invocation size explicitly since both live callers dispatch wave/cycle subsets.
deferred_self_modifying is an invocation-scoped exclusion set in mt_state_file, required for convergence.
Degradation (missing critical-paths file) is always visible: self_modifying:null, loud stderr, report SKIPPED line.
dead_ends: self_mod_match must not use `first // empty` when bound via `as $x |` outside an array comprehension -- silently drops the whole verdict.
Degraded-detection must not use `.self_modifying // "null"` in jq -- `//` treats literal false as falsy, misreading a valid false as degraded null.
